instructions.task: - Create unit tests for the module prompted at the endpoint; - Write the propose pathing for it at the end;
instructions.IMPORTANT: - Write Comments (initiating with @test) with PHPDoc-like syntax before the function signature to describe the behavior of the original tested method and document what it should do in natural language (similarly to how it is done with describe() and it() in Jest); - Since I'm using the Better Comments extension in VSCode, leverage the additional * for highlighting each content line (ignoring spacing-only lines), for instance: /** ** @test * ** This function is a test! **/
